Thanks — I reviewed the CAIQ template Markus attached and started a mapping between CAIQ questions and our evidence index. A few things to call out:

- Evidence retention: BlueLantern typically wants 3 years of artifacts for key SOC 2 controls (change management, incident logs). We currently have logs for 18 months in the default bucket and archives beyond that behind lifecycle rules. Need to confirm whether a PDF snapshot of retained logs is acceptable or if they require object-level access to archives.
- Third-party attestations: our SOC2 references subservice providers (cloud infra), I added a footnote in the template to point BlueLantern at the cloud provider SOC link.

I've attached an evidence-index-template.xlsx (internal format) — Kimberly, please use the file to map each CAIQ question to the artifact name and provide a short access path (drive link or presigned pattern). I'll mark items that will require a redaction review.

Hannah Schmitt
